name: Comment Completion Suppression Test
description: Test that completions are suppressed inside comments

testCases.name: Completion - Inside // comment should be empty
testCases.description: No completions should be offered inside // comments

testCases.name: Completion - Inside ; comment should be empty
testCases.description: No completions should be offered inside ; comments

testCases.name: Completion - Inside // comment with partial word should be empty
testCases.description: No completions should be offered inside // comments even with partial words

testCases.name: Completion - Inside ; comment with partial word should be empty
testCases.description: No completions should be offered inside ; comments even with partial words

testCases.name: Completion - After lda (NOT in comment) should show completions
testCases.description: Normal completions should still work outside comments

testCases.name: Completion - At start of line (NOT in comment) should show completions
testCases.description: Normal completions should still work at line start
